case_studies.title: Hello, Demo
case_studies.scenario: TinyTeach ships with a 'demo' provider that returns a hardcoded response. This lets you explore the full flow -- upload, generate, download -- with zero API cost.
case_studies.task: Pick any topic and switch LLM provider to 'demo' in the sidebar. Hit Generate and confirm you see this case study.
case_studies.real_world_analogy: Think of the demo provider as a flight simulator's practice mode -- you get the same cockpit, same controls, same checklist, but the airplane never leaves the ground.
case_studies.fun_fact: The LLMProvider interface (Phase 3) is borrowed from the Strategy pattern in the Gang-of-Four catalog -- the same pattern used in JDK's ResourceBundle and Python's logging.handlers.
hints: Open the sidebar and switch Provider: hf_inference -> demo.
case_studies.learning_objective: Understand that TinyTeach's LLM interface is decoupled from any single vendor.
